items.summary: Financial recommendation: approve only bounded report-only finance work and repair-or-close review; pause new discretionary production queues until attribution, contribution margin, and cost-to-learn are measurable. For 2026-09-21, Amazon reported 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, but all commission is in an aggregate row and site-attributed income is $0. From 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-25, AI usage cost is $921.96 across 5,093 calls, with 230 errors, while the scorecard records 0 proven outcomes. Revenue-to-cost ROI, contribution margin, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because revenue covers only one day, $4.92 is unattributed, fixed infrastructure costs and monthly budget limits are blank, and experiment outcomes are unproven. Minimum measurement: daily site/content-level revenue and commission attribution, shipped-item revenue, infrastructure invoices, and experiment-level incremental outcomes over a defined window.

The rc-9.com repair-or-close recommendation is financially sound. Existing evidence shows mobile performance 48, LCP 4,977ms, and TBT 1,513ms, but no repair cost, incremental revenue effect, or attribution evidence. Authorize read-only artifact review and require an explicit repair-or-close disposition before requeue. Do not claim financial benefit from the candidate performance score of 70 or TBT of 1,831ms; those are technical signals only.
